create_LinearReLU: create a torch.nn.qat.LinearReLU module with given input and output features for quantization-aware training
run_LinearReLU_forward: run a forward pass of a LinearReLU module on a random input tensor and verify output shape
build_LinearReLU_from_float: build a QAT LinearReLU module from a float torch.nn.Linear layer using from_float
convert_LinearReLU_to_float: convert a trained QAT LinearReLU module back to a float LinearReLU using to_float
test_LinearReLU_qat: test a LinearReLU module with fake quantization enabled for quantization-aware training workflows
